html:
The 2024 Da Nang International Fireworks Festival will take place in June and July, with the theme “Made in Unity – Global Connection – Radiant Five Continents”, promising to bring visitors a special event, with special performances in the sky, always captivating people.

This year’s Da Nang Fireworks Festival takes place in the summer, and this is also an event marking 12 years of organizing a vibrant fireworks program in the coastal city.

If visitors travel to Da Nang in the summer, they will be immersed in the atmosphere of the bustling fireworks festival, this year’s fireworks festival with the theme of conveying the message of a peaceful, friendly, humane world and honoring values ​​that inspire the community.

It can be said that DIFF is one of the festivals that helps tourists remember the summer of Da Nang beach, and this is also one of the annual festivals that brings exciting performances to the people and tourists at home and abroad.

This year’s DIFF includes 8 participating teams from countries such as: France, Italy, USA, Germany, Poland, Finland, China and the host team Da Nang (Vietnam) will bring the people and tourists the most eye-catching performances.

The opening ceremony starts on the night of June 8 with the theme “Made of Unique Culture – Cultural quintessence”, with the opening performance by the host team Vietnam and France, followed by the following nights with teams from other countries and will have 20-22 minutes of performance.

It can be said that the Da Nang International Fireworks Festival will be a great opportunity to help Da Nang attract domestic and international tourists to visit and enjoy. Besides the fireworks festival, Da Nang also holds many exciting events.
